command.umbra.shadow: A shadow detached and follows your path.
command.umbra.steps: Someone is walking behind you. Don't turn around.
command.umbra.mimic: That block is not what it seems anymore.
command.umbra.mimic_failed: Look at a crafting table, bookshelf, planks, cobblestone, stone bricks, barrel, furnace, hay bale, log or ore.
command.umbra.darkness: Seeded %s blocks of living darkness (it only lives in dark, enclosed places).
command.umbra.maze: A two-storey quantum maze appeared in front of you. The entrance is on its west side.
command.umbra.home: Home set here. Mimics will move in while you are away.
command.umbra.no_maze: You are not inside a quantum maze.
message.umbra.bad_frame: The dusk stone doesn't meet: the frame must be even and closed, no narrower than two, no lower than three.
command.umbra.rift: A rift to the Underside opened in front of you.
command.umbra.journal.all: Journal fully opened: %s entries, with the recipes they unlock.
message.umbra.no_room: There is no room for it to appear here.
message.umbra.only_underside: This only works in the Underside.
message.umbra.freed: The Primordial Shadow is gone. Your own shadow bows to you — from now on it fights at your side.
message.umbra.compass_none: The needle spins: no quantum maze nearby.
message.umbra.compass: The maze is in '%s' — it changes its mind in %s s
journal.umbra.start.title: First page
journal.umbra.start.text: Something is wrong with this world after dark. I will write everything down, or I will think I am losing my mind. Sugar, berries and a scrap of paper: grandmother made a sedative like that. It will come in handy.
journal.umbra.shadow.title: My shadow
journal.umbra.shadow.text: Tonight my shadow came loose. It walks exactly where I walked. When I stand, it catches up; when I move, it falls behind. Light slows it down. Maybe light in my hand would tear it apart?
journal.umbra.shadow_dispelled.title: Light against shadow
journal.umbra.shadow_dispelled.text: It worked. The shadow left a shard behind: cold, humming. Pressed into cobbled deepslate it would darken the stone like dusk. From such stone one could build a door. To wherever it came from. And three sedatives, a crystal and a shard should make something stronger than pills.
journal.umbra.steps.title: Footsteps
journal.umbra.steps.text: Someone walked behind me, step for step. When I turned around, there was nobody. Do not let them get close.
journal.umbra.mimic.title: Not my crafting table
journal.umbra.mimic.text: Something was wrong: the wrong pattern, the wrong sound underfoot. Every kind of mimic has its own tell, and I will write each down as I meet it. Hit first, or shine a light, and it gives up. Never open or mine what looks wrong.
journal.umbra.darkness.title: Living darkness
journal.umbra.darkness.text: Deep down the dark moves by itself. It eats torches. It leaves lanterns alone. Luminite burns it away, and the eternal torches are too much for it.
journal.umbra.maze.title: A maze that looks back
journal.umbra.maze.text: Walls that exist only while you look at them. Turn away and the maze thinks. A compass ringed with echo quartz would probably hear what about.
journal.umbra.sanity.title: Edges of sight
journal.umbra.sanity.text: Figures at the edge of my eye, sounds that are not there. Light helps, and sleep, and warm food. They say answers sometimes come in madness itself. I do not want to find out. I probably will.
journal.umbra.luminite.title: Luminite
journal.umbra.luminite.text: Deep down there is a crystal that glows by itself, and the dark fears it. In glass, a lamp. On a stick, a torch that never goes out. Glass, iron and a crystal: a lantern to hold, fed with more crystals. An ordinary lantern wrapped in crystals and iron should make a flash to strike the dark with. Nuggets, glass and a crystal: a small mirror that shows what is pretending.
journal.umbra.underside.title: The Underside
journal.umbra.underside.text: Ash for ground, stone for sky. No light of its own; torches smoulder and die. The ore here is darker than night: it will make steel harder than diamond. Quartz that echoes, with steel and a shard... seals? Like invitations. And one more thought: a luminite lamp wrapped in steel, crystals and quartz would make a circle of light they cannot enter.
journal.umbra.crawler.title: Crawler
journal.umbra.crawler.text: Climbs walls and leaps out of the dark. A flash of light makes it recoil.
journal.umbra.blind.title: The Blind
journal.umbra.blind.text: It has no eyes. It hears. Sneak. Freeze. It will walk past.
journal.umbra.light_eater.title: Light Eater
journal.umbra.light_eater.text: A pale moth that passes through walls to eat any light. Luminite is too bright for it.
journal.umbra.mimicker.title: Mimicker
journal.umbra.mimicker.text: I heard a cow in the ruins. There are no cows in the Underside.
journal.umbra.shade.title: Shades
journal.umbra.shade.text: Small, weak, never alone. Bright light burns them. Sometimes they leave a shard.
journal.umbra.watcher.title: The Watcher
journal.umbra.watcher.text: It only moved while I looked at it. It is gone now. Its eye is still warm. If I gather all four (eye, crown, crook, mask) and bind them with a block of gloom steel, I will have a key. A key to something behind the gates in the caves.
journal.umbra.mimic_queen.title: Mimic Queen
journal.umbra.mimic_queen.text: She hid among her brood and in the walls of the room. I dragged her into the light. Her crown is part of the key.
journal.umbra.shepherd.title: Shepherd of Darkness
journal.umbra.shepherd.text: Invulnerable in his shroud of dark until light burned it off. His crook is part of the key.
journal.umbra.doppelganger.title: Doppelganger
journal.umbra.doppelganger.text: It wore my armour and walked where I had walked. Fighting yourself is exhausting. Its mask is part of the key.
journal.umbra.architect.title: The Architect
journal.umbra.architect.text: The one who built the mazes; he slept behind the seal at the end of the citadel. The abyss itself beats in his heart, and with that heart I can call the oldest one.
journal.umbra.primordial_shadow.title: Primordial Shadow
journal.umbra.primordial_shadow.text: The first shadow, the one all others fall from. At the end only light could touch it.
journal.umbra.freed.title: My shadow is mine again
journal.umbra.freed.text: Now it walks beside me and strikes anything that comes too close. The nights are quieter. Shift + right-click the shadow: "stay here" or "follow me".
block.umbra.ward.full: The ward is full of light.
item.umbra.luminite_lantern.empty: The lantern is empty. It waits for a crystal, if you crouch and offer one.
journal.umbra.insight_1.title: Insight: whispers
journal.umbra.insight_1.text: I heard them. Not voices: a whisper between thoughts. They told me how to build a table where they are clearer: a book, two shadow shards, planks beneath. It only works while my head is loud. Calm, the words fall apart. The first thing they gave me: a bottle, a shard and a luminite crystal make a tincture of silence.
journal.umbra.nightmare.title: Nightmare
journal.umbra.nightmare.text: I fell asleep and woke up somewhere else. Moving walls, darkness, something close. Up above there was a light: the way out. I think I made it. If I end up there again: find the light upstairs. Sleeping next to a burning ward is probably calmer.
journal.umbra.insight_2.title: Insight: the mask
journal.umbra.insight_2.text: The whisper is louder. Now I see what hides. A carved pumpkin, four shadow shards and an echo quartz at the whisper table: a madman's mask. It will show me the unseen. It will take a little more of me.
journal.umbra.insight_3.title: Insight: despair
journal.umbra.insight_3.text: I am barely me any more. It is clarity. A gloom sword, four shards and two echo quartz at the whisper table: the blade of despair. The less sanity is left in me, the deeper it cuts.
journal.umbra.whisper.2: you are not writing this alone
journal.umbra.whisper.6: it is standing behind you, reading
message.umbra.nightmare.start: You wake up... but this is not your home. Somewhere above, a light is burning.
message.umbra.nightmare.minute: The dream is wearing thin. One minute left.
message.umbra.nightmare.escaped: You touched the light and truly woke up. Something cold is in your hand.
message.umbra.nightmare.failed: You wake up in a cold sweat.
ritual.umbra.nothing: The table is silent. I do not understand anything yet.
ritual.umbra.unknown: The whisper says nothing about this.
ritual.umbra.too_sane: The whisper is too quiet. I am still too much myself.
ritual.umbra.silence_tincture.need: a glass bottle in hand, a shadow shard, a luminite crystal
ritual.umbra.madman_mask.need: a carved pumpkin in hand, 4 shadow shards, an echo quartz
ritual.umbra.despair_blade.need: a gloom sword in hand, 4 shadow shards, 2 echo quartz
item.umbra.silence_tincture.drunk: Silence settles in your head. For a while.
journal.umbra.shadow_village.title: A village that isn't
journal.umbra.shadow_village.text: Houses stand in the ash: crooked, roofless, around a well with no water. They live there. Long noses, quiet voices, all grey, like the shadows of people. They trade for shadow shards and echo quartz; there is even bread. Only, one of them did not blink for far too long. Mirror, flash, or strike first: there are changelings here too. But hit a real one by mistake and it will be hard to forget.
message.umbra.citadel.enter: The walls close behind you. Somewhere ahead, past the maze, the dark and the books, sleeps the one who built all this.
message.umbra.citadel.sealed: The door is sealed. A key of four parts is carved into it.
message.umbra.key.pull: The key tugs at your hand: the Quantum Citadel, ~%s blocks %s.
message.umbra.key.inside: The key trembles. The sealed door is somewhere at the far end of the citadel.
message.umbra.compass_citadel: No maze nearby, but the needle leans towards a citadel: ~%s blocks %s.
journal.umbra.citadel.title: The Quantum Citadel
journal.umbra.citadel.text: The gate in the cave did not lead down, but up: into a citadel above the ceiling of the world. A maze, then a hall full of living darkness where statues stand. A vault where the chests are hungry. A library. At the very end, a sealed door with the same pattern as my key. One wall in the library whispers: I think you can only walk through it if you have nearly lost your mind. Or are wearing the mask.
journal.umbra.statue.title: The statues
journal.umbra.statue.text: They did not move while I looked at them. I blinked, and they were closer. A flash of light turns them to stone for a few seconds. Never turn your back.
journal.umbra.keeper.title: The Keeper
journal.umbra.keeper.text: Huge, slow, hits hard enough to black out. Sometimes leaps across the whole hall. Light stuns it: that is when to strike back.
command.umbra.nightmare_failed: A nightmare can only be called in the overworld, while awake.
journal.umbra.mimic_crafting_table.title: Mimic: crafting table
journal.umbra.mimic_crafting_table.text: The tools on its sides hang sideways, as if the table had lain down and stood up again. Steps beside it sound sticky, like honey.
journal.umbra.mimic_bookshelf.title: Mimic: bookshelf
journal.umbra.mimic_bookshelf.text: The books are wrong: lying on their sides, spines up. Real shelves never look like that.
journal.umbra.mimic_planks.title: Mimic: planks
journal.umbra.mimic_planks.text: The boards run the wrong way: the gaps go up and down. A floor of it sounds like honey underfoot.
journal.umbra.mimic_stone.title: Mimic: stone
journal.umbra.mimic_stone.text: The masonry stands on its edge, the seams run vertically. The worst ones only give themselves away by the sound of steps, or in the mirror.
journal.umbra.mimic_barrel.title: Mimic: barrel
journal.umbra.mimic_barrel.text: The hoops run lengthwise, as if the barrel had been knocked over and never stood up.
journal.umbra.mimic_furnace.title: Mimic: furnace
journal.umbra.mimic_furnace.text: The furnace door is turned on its side. It never burns, whatever you put in.
journal.umbra.mimic_hay.title: Mimic: hay bale
journal.umbra.mimic_hay.text: The bands on the bale run the wrong way. And it does not smell like hay.
journal.umbra.mimic_log.title: Mimic: log
journal.umbra.mimic_log.text: The bark runs across the trunk, the rings are not where they should be.
journal.umbra.mimic_ore.title: Mimic: ore
journal.umbra.mimic_ore.text: The veins are turned, the pattern slightly off. Start mining and it bites. Only light: one flash of the Dispeller and it gives up.
journal.umbra.mimic_chest.title: Mimic: chest
journal.umbra.mimic_chest.text: Stand next to it and listen: it breathes. Hit it first and it gives up everything it swallowed.
journal.umbra.mimic_villager.title: Mimic: villager
journal.umbra.mimic_villager.text: It did not blink for far too long. The mirror sparks above it. Do not trade with it: strike first or shine a light.
item.umbra.explorer_note.known: You have already read everything they left.
journal.umbra.note_1.title: Note: "Day one"
journal.umbra.note_1.text: There are seven of us. We went through the rift the village spoke of: ash, stone overhead, not one dawn. Marta said one can live here. I am writing this in case she is wrong.
journal.umbra.note_2.title: Note: "Torches"
journal.umbra.note_2.text: Torches die here within minutes. Jan found a glowing crystal in the wall; its light does not fade. We sleep around it like around a fire.
journal.umbra.note_3.title: Note: "The village"
journal.umbra.note_3.text: We found a village. The folk are grey and quiet, they say little, but their bread is real. One of them stared at Jan for far too long. At night Jan went to the well and never came back.
journal.umbra.note_4.title: Note: "The bell"
journal.umbra.note_4.text: The bell rings by itself, and every time someone stands beneath it. Marta says it is the wind. There is no wind here.
journal.umbra.note_5.title: Note: "The statues"
journal.umbra.note_5.text: We saw people made of ash. In the morning there were three by the camp, by evening five, and closer. We left without looking back. You must not look back, that much I understood.
journal.umbra.note_6.title: Note: "The gate"
journal.umbra.note_6.text: An arch in the rock, its doorway glowing. Marta says beyond it is a city, built by the one who built the mazes. She wants to find a way out there. I want to find Jan.
journal.umbra.note_7.title: Note: "The library"
journal.umbra.note_7.text: One wall in the library whispers. Marta walked through it; she was already unwell then. I could not: I am still too much myself. She came back with a key drawn on her palm.
journal.umbra.note_8.title: Note: "The last one"
journal.umbra.note_8.text: There are two of us left, and Marta is no longer Marta: she looks at me the way that villager looked at Jan. If you are reading this, shine a light in her face. If that does not help, run to the seal. The key has four parts. I am sorry.
item.umbra.despair_blade.bonus: Right now: +%s damage from lost sanity
message.umbra.ally.stay: Your shadow stays here on guard.
journal.umbra.pick: Pick an entry on the left. Empty pages fill in once you see it for yourself.
command.umbra.storm.on: An ash storm rises for you (stand in the ash plains).
journal.umbra.crystal_grottos.title: Crystal Grottos
journal.umbra.crystal_grottos.text: Light, for the first time in the Underside. Luminite grows out of the rock in whole columns. But the light is not mine: light eaters flock to it, and there are many. Four crystals pressed together make a geode that glows on its own.
journal.umbra.black_lakes.title: Black Lakes
journal.umbra.black_lakes.text: The water is black as ink: put your hand in and it is gone. Sometimes a pale light kindles in the depth, then something splashes. I do not want to go in.
journal.umbra.sunken_temple.title: Temple Under Water
journal.umbra.sunken_temple.text: Columns stuck out of the lake. Below, under the black water, stands a temple with a fallen roof, an altar and a chest inside. Someone prayed here before the water came. The lights by the door are not lanterns.
journal.umbra.whispering_forest.title: Whispering Forest
journal.umbra.whispering_forest.text: The dead trees stand so close that something whispers between them. When I ran, the whisper grew louder, then fell silent, and they stepped out from behind the trunks. Here you walk. Slowly.
journal.umbra.ash_storm.title: Ash Storm
journal.umbra.ash_storm.text: Ash rises over the plains and the world shrinks to ten steps. Someone walks close by in the storm, I hear the steps. Better to wait it out by a fire or under a roof.
journal.umbra.lurker.title: Lurker
journal.umbra.lurker.text: Long as an eel, with a light on a stalk above its jaws. It only hunts what is in the water: grabs and drags to the bottom. On the shore it is helpless, and light sends it into the deep.
command.umbra.citadel.outside: You are not inside a citadel.
item.umbra.keeper_page.known: You have read everything the Keepers left.
journal.umbra.keeper_1.title: Keepers: "The Vein"
journal.umbra.keeper_1.text: We, the Keepers of the Vein, write for those who come down after us. A blue vein runs under the hills; it shines and does not burn. We call it luminite. Set a crystal in a frame of iron grains and glass: such a mirror throws light back, and what watches from the dark looks away.
journal.umbra.keeper_2.title: Keepers: "The Ward"
journal.umbra.keeper_2.text: A lamp shines, but the shadow comes to the lamp too. We wrapped it on every side: dark ingots, echo quartz, crystals. It became a ward: within its light the shadow weakens and does not dare come near. Set it where you sleep.
journal.umbra.keeper_3.title: Keepers: "Fire and Arrow"
journal.umbra.keeper_3.text: A crystal on the arrowhead flares at the strike and lights whatever it hit. A crystal in the heart of a torch will not let it die: that is how we got the eternal fire for the mines. Both are simple, but you need many crystals.
journal.umbra.keeper_4.title: Keepers: "The Dispeller"
journal.umbra.keeper_4.text: A device that gives a flash at your word, and everything living in the dark recoils. One flash, then it cools; do not waste it. And a lantern for the hand: a light you can carry. The shadow does not like to come near us when we carry a light.
journal.umbra.keeper_5.title: Keepers: "Silence"
journal.umbra.keeper_5.text: Whoever hears voices must learn to be silent. A tincture of silence, from a crystal and herbs: for five minutes the head stays clear and nothing puts out the light in your eyes. We drank it before every descent. Those who did not came back changed.
journal.umbra.keeper_6.title: Keepers: "A Warning"
journal.umbra.keeper_6.text: If you listen to the whispering too long, it will start to suggest recipes. Do not believe it: everything madness teaches is paid for with your mind and only makes things darker. The bright craft is taught by stone and labour.
journal.umbra.keeper_7.title: Keepers: "The Fire on the Cliff"
journal.umbra.keeper_7.text: The last of us stayed at the great fire on the black cliff above the lake. He did not leave with the rest; he keeps the light. If you are reading this, go towards the light. That fire has not gone out; it only lacks luminite.
block.umbra.lighthouse_lamp.dead: The lamp is dead. It needs %s more crystals to wake.
block.umbra.lighthouse_lamp.status: Lamp: level %s of %s, shelters %s blocks. Crystals to the next level: %s.
block.umbra.lighthouse_lamp.max: The lamp burns at full strength: the dark keeps %s blocks away.
block.umbra.lighthouse_lamp.grew: The lamp flares up: level %s of %s. Safe zone: %s blocks.
block.umbra.lighthouse_lamp.full: The lamp already burns at full strength.
message.umbra.marta_map: Ash-ink marks a lighthouse on the map: ~%s blocks %s.
message.umbra.marta_map_blank: The map is blank: the ash ink only shows in the Underside.
message.umbra.note_map: A folded map was tucked inside the note.
journal.umbra.bestiary.hint0: You have only seen it from afar. Defeat it and you will learn how it lives.
journal.umbra.bestiary.hint1: You know its habits. Defeat it %s more time(s) to learn what stops it.
dialogue.umbra.yan.intro: Yan: "You came with the map? I am Yan. I have kept this lamp since I left the well. It is dead, but not forever: it needs luminite. Four crystals wake it, then four more for every new ring of light."
dialogue.umbra.yan.dead: Yan: "The lamp sleeps. It needs luminite, four crystals to begin. Do not stint: afterwards it will shelter you."
dialogue.umbra.yan.level1: Yan: "It burns. Faintly, but it burns. The dark no longer creeps to the foot of the tower. A little more and the light will reach the shore."
dialogue.umbra.yan.level2: Yan: "Now it shows far. I remembered a name: Marta. She brought the first crystal here. Keep feeding the lamp and I will tell you the rest."
dialogue.umbra.yan.level3: Yan: "Almost. The beam is already cutting the ceiling. One more ring and no shadow will dare come near the lighthouse."
dialogue.umbra.yan.max: Yan: "It burns the way it did when she was here. Thank you. Now I can stand at the window and simply look. If you meet her at the seal, shine a light in her face: the real one will remember."
journal.umbra.marta_map.title: Marta's Map
journal.umbra.marta_map.text: Her hand, her writing, but the ink is ash. A lighthouse on the edge of black water is marked on the map, and under it a line: "Yan is waiting. A lamp without light, like us without each other." In the Underside the map can be unfolded to show the way.
journal.umbra.lighthouse.title: The Lighthouse
journal.umbra.lighthouse.text: A tower some sixty blocks tall on a rock, and at the very top a glass room with a dead lamp. A house and a dock at its foot. The lamp takes luminite: four crystals wake it, each four more widen the circle of safety and lengthen the beam. Inside the circle the dark cannot live.
journal.umbra.yan_1.title: Yan at the Lighthouse
journal.umbra.yan_1.text: The keeper of the lighthouse is Yan. The very Yan from the notes, who vanished at the well. Grey and quiet like the village folk, but he remembers names. He says the lamp went out the day Marta left, and while it is dead the Underside takes more and more.
journal.umbra.yan_2.title: Yan: About Marta
journal.umbra.yan_2.text: The lamp flared and Yan began to talk. Marta was not looking for a way out: she was looking for a way to bring light back to the Underside, because here it ran out before they did. She took the first crystal from the lighthouse to light the gates with it, and on the way she was replaced. He knew it by how she stopped looking at the lamp.
journal.umbra.yan_3.title: Yan: The Light Burns
journal.umbra.yan_3.text: The lamp burns at full strength. Yan said he was replaced at the well in exactly the same way: the folk needed a face in someone else's place. But the lamp does not burn him, which means he is still Yan. Now he stands at the window and simply watches the light.
journal.umbra.yan_4.title: Yan: Thanks
journal.umbra.yan_4.text: Yan gave me what he had saved by the lamp: crystals, shards and a page of the Keepers. He said the real Marta is not found with a sword but with light in the face. If she is still anywhere, it is at the seal at the end of the citadel.
journal.umbra.quest_crystals.title: A Light for the Village
journal.umbra.quest_crystals.text: Bring 6 luminite crystals. Reward: 3 shadow shards.
quest.umbra.crystals.ask: "We need light. Bring six luminite crystals and I will give you shards."
quest.umbra.crystals.thanks: "They are warm. Thank you, they will last the month."
journal.umbra.quest_shades.title: The Pack at the Gate
quest.umbra.shades.ask: "Shades walk by our doors in packs. Kill eight and we will sleep easier."
quest.umbra.shades.thanks: "It is quieter. Take this, it is all the bright we have."
journal.umbra.quest_crawlers.title: The Ones on the Walls
quest.umbra.crawlers.ask: "Something climbs the walls over our roofs. Kill four crawlers."
quest.umbra.crawlers.thanks: "The roofs are whole. The quartz is yours."
journal.umbra.quest_blinds.title: The Blind on the Road
quest.umbra.blinds.ask: "The blind walk the road to the well and hear every step. Kill three."
quest.umbra.blinds.thanks: "The road is clear. Here is medicine, it eases the mind."
journal.umbra.quest_eaters.title: Who Eats the Fire
journal.umbra.quest_eaters.text: Kill 3 light eaters. Reward: 4 luminite crystals.
quest.umbra.eaters.ask: "They devour our lamps. Kill three light eaters."
quest.umbra.eaters.thanks: "The lamps burn till morning. Take the crystals."
journal.umbra.quest_mimickers.title: The Voice of the Cow
quest.umbra.mimickers.ask: "We have no cows, yet we hear mooing. Kill three mimickers."
journal.umbra.quest_quartz.title: Quartz for the Bell
journal.umbra.quest_quartz.text: Bring 4 echo quartz. Reward: 3 luminite crystals.
quest.umbra.quartz.ask: "The bell tolls by itself because it has no echo. Bring four echo quartz."
quest.umbra.quartz.thanks: "The bell sounds as it should. Here."
journal.umbra.quest_page.title: A Page from the Mine
journal.umbra.quest_page.text: Bring a Keepers' page. Reward: 5 luminite crystals.
quest.umbra.page.ask: "My grandfather worked in the old mine. If you find a Keepers' page, bring it to me."
journal.umbra.quest_temple.title: The Sunken Temple
journal.umbra.quest_temple.text: Find the sunken temple. Reward: 3 echo quartz.
quest.umbra.temple.ask: "A temple stands at the bottom of the black lake. Find it and tell me what is there."
quest.umbra.temple.thanks: "So it exists. This is for your courage."
journal.umbra.quest_lurker.title: The Lurker
journal.umbra.quest_lurker.text: Kill a lurker. Reward: 4 shadow shards.
quest.umbra.lurker.ask: "A creature with a light lives in the lake. Kill a lurker and we can draw water."
quest.umbra.lurker.thanks: "Now the water is clean. The shards are yours."
journal.umbra.quest_citadel.title: The Arch in the Rock
journal.umbra.quest_citadel.text: Find the quantum citadel. Reward: an antipsychotic.
quest.umbra.citadel.ask: "An arch stands in the rock, and its passage glows. Find it and come back alive."
quest.umbra.citadel.thanks: "You came back, which is already a lot. Take a pill."
journal.umbra.quest_lighthouse.title: The Fire on the Cliff
journal.umbra.quest_lighthouse.text: Reach the lighthouse. Reward: 6 luminite crystals.
quest.umbra.lighthouse.ask: "They say a lighthouse stood on a cliff. Reach it and see whether it still stands."
quest.umbra.lighthouse.thanks: "So the fire can still be lit. Take these, the lamp will need them."
journal.umbra.crawler.look: Something dark crawls the wall like a spider, but too long. It moves in jerks.
journal.umbra.crawler.weak: A flash of light throws it back and wounds it. The Dispeller and light arrows hit it harder than a sword. Do not stand by a wall; in the open it loses its edge.
journal.umbra.blind.look: A huge faceless figure wanders the cave, its head turning to sounds.
journal.umbra.blind.weak: It hears running and walking but almost not sneaking. Freeze or sneak, and strike once it passes. A flash of light stuns it: slowed and weakened.
journal.umbra.light_eater.look: A pale blur drifts by the walls and reaches for any flame.
journal.umbra.light_eater.weak: It passes through walls, but luminite and eternal torches are beyond it. Stand under them; a flash of light stuns and wounds it.
journal.umbra.mimicker.look: You hear a cow, but there is no cow. The air nearby shivers slightly.
journal.umbra.mimicker.weak: It is invisible until you come close. A flash of light exposes it, weakens it and makes it glow. A blow at the invisible thing also reveals it.
journal.umbra.shade.look: Small dark silhouettes, quick and always in a pack.
journal.umbra.shade.weak: Light burns them, and the Dispeller destroys them at once. Any light in your hand slowly burns them while they are near.
journal.umbra.lurker.look: A light flickers in the black water, and something long beneath it.
journal.umbra.lurker.weak: It hunts only what is in the water. On the shore it is helpless and dries out. A flash of light wounds it and drives it into the deep.
journal.umbra.statue.look: A figure of ash stands motionless. It stood further away before.
journal.umbra.statue.weak: While you look at it, it does not move. A flash of light turns it to stone for a few seconds, and then you can strike.
journal.umbra.keeper.look: A huge slow armoured figure stands in the middle of the hall.
journal.umbra.keeper.weak: Slow, but hits hard and sometimes leaps across the hall. Light slows and weakens it: strike while it is dazed.
journal.umbra.watcher.look: A thin figure in the distance. Every time you look away, it is closer.
journal.umbra.watcher.weak: It moves only while watched. Do not look away for long or it will rise before your eyes. Light wounds it.
journal.umbra.mimic_queen.look: Something stirs among the chests and walls. The room is not what it was.
journal.umbra.mimic_queen.weak: She hides among her brood and is invulnerable while hidden. Kill the mimickers or light her up and she will come out. She leaps, and is stunned after the leap.
journal.umbra.shepherd.look: A dark mass with a crook, wrapped in writhing darkness.
journal.umbra.shepherd.weak: While the shroud holds he cannot be harmed. Burn it away with the Dispeller, then strike. He calls shades, but they are weak to light.
journal.umbra.doppelganger.look: Someone in your armour walks in your footsteps.
journal.umbra.doppelganger.weak: He repeats your steps three seconds late and takes your weapon. Do not stand still or walk straight. He is stunned after a swap.
journal.umbra.architect.look: The maze rearranges around you, and a tall figure steps out of the walls.
journal.umbra.architect.weak: He rearranges the maze and steps through walls. Upset him with light: after a flash he is stunned and loses the walls. The shades from the cracks are weak to light.
journal.umbra.primordial_shadow.look: The shadow all others fall from.
journal.umbra.primordial_shadow.weak: Three stages. First the swarm, then the dark she hides in (burn it away), and at the end only light can hurt her: strike with a light in hand or flash her with the Dispeller.
enchantment.umbra.echo.desc: A blow sounds again half a second later, weaker.
enchantment.umbra.silence.desc: Quieter steps: the blind and the steps behind you notice you less.
enchantment.umbra.void.desc: The dark drains your mind more slowly.
enchantment.umbra.harvest.desc: Creatures of the Underside leave more shards, quartz and crystals.
enchantment.umbra.taste_of_darkness.desc: Killing a creature of the Underside heals you, at a small cost to your mind.
enchantment.umbra.flash.desc: An arrow may flare on impact and stun a creature of the dark.
enchantment.umbra.anchor.desc: Harder to push around: bosses and lurkers cannot shift you.
enchantment.umbra.instinct.desc: Creatures of the dark glow through walls, mimickers too.
enchantment.umbra.whisper_curse.desc: The whisper never stops and slowly drains your mind.
artifact.umbra.ash_clasp.effect: On a chestplate: quiet steps, no fall damage, storms do not blind.
artifact.umbra.architect_seal.effect: On a chestplate: see through phantom walls; the maze stops reshuffling.
artifact.umbra.how: Pin it to a chestplate at an anvil.
item.umbra.luminite_shield.tip: Held in a hand: halves blows from creatures and burns whoever strikes you.
advancement.umbra.root.title: Umbra
item.umbra.keeper_horn.unbound: The horn is silent. It doesn't yet know which lighthouse to call: press it to the lamp.
item.umbra.keeper_horn.quiet: All is quiet at the lighthouse (%s, %s). The horn will call when the dark comes for it.
item.umbra.keeper_horn.bound: The horn is bound to the lighthouse (%s, %s).
item.umbra.keeper_horn.arrived: The horn throws you to the foot of the tower. They are already coming.
item.umbra.primordial_heart.chosen: You have already made your choice. The heart is silent.
item.umbra.primordial_heart.too_bright: The heart will not open in the light. Burn it in a lighthouse at full strength, or take it in the dark.
item.umbra.primordial_heart.lamp_weak: The lamp is too weak for the heart: it needs level %s.
message.umbra.heart: Her heart is left behind. Burn it in a lighthouse at full strength, or take it into yourself in the dark. The choice is final.
event.umbra.onslaught.start: The dark has noticed the lighthouse. It is coming for the tower — keep it from the foot!
event.umbra.onslaught.horn: The Keeper's horn trembles: the dark is coming for the lighthouse (%s, %s)! Blow the horn to go there.
event.umbra.onslaught.wave: Onslaught of the dark — wave %s of %s
event.umbra.onslaught.pause: Onslaught of the dark — a lull after wave %s of %s
event.umbra.onslaught.won: The onslaught is broken. The lighthouse burns, and a reward waits at its foot.
event.umbra.onslaught.lost: The dark reached the lighthouse. Its light falls by one level.
ending.umbra.light.title: Dawn
ending.umbra.light.subtitle: The heart of the dark burned in the lighthouse
ending.umbra.light.1: The lamp flared so bright that for a moment the whole Underside could be seen, edge to edge.
ending.umbra.light.2: The heart of the Primordial Shadow cracked and fell to ash, and the ash never landed — it melted away.
ending.umbra.light.3: Shadows still live in the corners, steps still sound at night. But now they are only shadows and only steps.
ending.umbra.light.4: The Keepers of the Vein waited centuries for this day. Yan would say the fire finally reached the bottom.
ending.umbra.light.5: The dark no longer holds you. You can sleep.
ending.umbra.dark.title: Darkness
ending.umbra.dark.subtitle: You took the heart of the Primordial Shadow
ending.umbra.dark.1: The heart lay warm in your palm and began to beat in time with yours.
ending.umbra.dark.2: The dark stopped being dark: now you see in it, and it sees you as its own.
ending.umbra.dark.3: The creatures of the Underside step aside. They will not touch you until you touch them.
ending.umbra.dark.4: Only the sun weighs on your shoulders now, and your thoughts will never be quite clear again.
ending.umbra.dark.5: You did not defeat the dark. You became it.
ending.umbra.thanks: The end. Thank you for playing Umbra. The world stays with you — play on.
journal.umbra.onslaught.title: Onslaught
journal.umbra.onslaught.text: A lighthouse can be seen from far away, and not only by me. The dark came in waves, and not for me but for the tower: for its foot, to gnaw at its light. While it lasts the lamp does not drive them off. Let too many through and the lighthouse falls by a level. A Keeper's horn bound to the lamp will call me wherever I am.
journal.umbra.onslaught_won.title: The lighthouse held
journal.umbra.onslaught_won.text: Three waves, and then silence. Crystals and shards were left at the foot of the tower, as if the dark pays for losing. The lighthouse burns. So it can be held.
journal.umbra.ending_light.title: Dawn
journal.umbra.ending_light.text: I burned the heart of the Primordial Shadow in a lighthouse lamp. The dark no longer holds me: the horrors come no harder than on my first night, and my mind wears down half as fast. My shadow is still loyal.
journal.umbra.ending_dark.title: Darkness
journal.umbra.ending_dark.text: I took the heart. Now I see in the dark, and the creatures of the Underside leave me be until I strike first. But the sun weighs on me, and my mind never rises above sixty again. The great ones still remember who I am.
advancement.umbra.start.desc: Open the journal that writes itself.
advancement.umbra.sanity.desc: Notice your mind wearing down in the dark.
advancement.umbra.luminite.desc: Find luminite, a stone that shines from within.
advancement.umbra.shadow_dispelled.desc: Dispel your own shadow with light.
advancement.umbra.steps.desc: Turn around to the steps behind you.
advancement.umbra.mimic.desc: Find a mimic among your things.
advancement.umbra.darkness.desc: Meet the living darkness in the deep.
advancement.umbra.sunken_temple.desc: Go down into the sunken temple.
advancement.umbra.lurker.desc: Meet what waits in the black lake.
advancement.umbra.keeper_7.desc: Collect every page of the Keepers of the Vein.
advancement.umbra.lighthouse.desc: Find a lighthouse of the Underside.
advancement.umbra.yan_4.desc: Light a lighthouse to full strength.
advancement.umbra.onslaught_won.desc: Break an onslaught of the dark on a lighthouse.
block.umbra.echo_altar.status: Candles around: %s, echo %s. Price: %s echo quartz and %s experience points. Candles short of the next echo: %s.
block.umbra.echo_altar.nothing: The echo has nothing to say to this.
block.umbra.echo_altar.price: The altar asks %s echo quartz and %s experience points.
block.umbra.echo_altar.cursed: The echo answered: %s… and something whispered back.
block.umbra.gloom_anvil.foreign: The gloom anvil does not know this: it mends only Umbra's gear.
block.umbra.gloom_anvil.need: Mending needs %s (or echo quartz) in your pack.
message.umbra.compass_maze: The needle leans towards a maze: ~%s blocks, %s.
message.umbra.shepherd.lanterns: The Shepherd lights his soul lanterns. While they burn, his flock shields him.
night.umbra.blood_moon: The moon is the colour of rust tonight. They see it too.
night.umbra.fog: Fog crawls up from the lowlands. Steps in it sound closer than they are.
night.umbra.silence: It has gone very quiet. Too quiet.
dialogue.umbra.yan.dawn: Yan: “Hear that? Nothing scratches below any more. For the first time in forty years I put the lamp out for the night, and nothing happened. Stay if you like. There is tea.”
dialogue.umbra.yan.dark: Yan (without turning round): “The light doesn't warm you any more, does it? I can see the shadow leaving you. I won't put the lamp out. Stand by the door if you must, but don't come in.”
block.umbra.trophy_shelf.full: All six are in place. The shelf sighs, and what they once guarded spills out from under it.
block.umbra.echo_altar.resonance: The echo did not die away. It stayed in the item and hums.
enchantment.umbra.resonance.desc: A blow rings through every creature nearby.
journal.umbra.weak_watcher.title: The Eye Under Armour
journal.umbra.weak_watcher.text: My blows slide off its lids. But when I caught its gaze in a mirror and held it, it froze as if it saw itself. Then it is soft.
journal.umbra.weak_mimic_queen.title: The Queen Behind Them
journal.umbra.weak_mimic_queen.text: While her children snap around her she barely feels pain. The brood first, then the mother. And she dislikes the light.
journal.umbra.weak_shepherd.title: Three Little Fires
journal.umbra.weak_shepherd.text: The Shepherd lit lanterns on the walls, and a thread runs from each to him. While one burns, the flock holds him up. Lanterns break.
journal.umbra.weak_doppelganger.title: Face to Face
journal.umbra.weak_doppelganger.text: It repeats my every move, and its face cannot be reached. But a reflection has no back. Go round.
journal.umbra.weak_architect.title: Stone Skin
journal.umbra.weak_architect.text: It is built of the same walls as its mazes, and a sword hardly bites them. A flash of light makes the stone crack for a moment.
journal.umbra.weak_primordial_shadow.tex: Light cannot wound her while she is strong. Only at the very end, as she melts, does it go in deep.
journal.umbra.night_blood_moon.title: Rust Moon
journal.umbra.night_blood_moon.text: Under a moon like that there are more of them, and my head hums louder. Better to wait it out by a light than to wander.
journal.umbra.night_fog.title: Fog
journal.umbra.night_fog.text: In the fog someone walks in my footsteps. I turn, and nobody is there. The white murk hides them and me alike.
journal.umbra.night_silence.title: Silence
journal.umbra.night_silence.text: All night there was not a sound, even the zombies were quiet. Then towards morning the silence burst into a scream. I don't like quiet nights now.
journal.umbra.trophy_shelf.title: Yan's Shelf
journal.umbra.trophy_shelf.text: Six of them stand side by side on one board. From here they watch each other, not me. Yan says they rest easier this way.
journal.umbra.yan_dawn.title: Dawn at the Lighthouse
journal.umbra.yan_dawn.text: Yan put out the lamp and sits on the porch with tea. The first time I've seen him smile.
tip.umbra.echo_altar: The echo runs deeper where luminite candles burn around it.
tip.umbra.melted_luminite_candle: Dim, but enough for the altar.
tip.umbra.luminite_candelabrum: Three flames on one stem. The altar counts each one thrice.
tip.umbra.gloom_anvil: Mends with gloom, luminite or echo quartz. Binds artifacts to a chestplate, relics to a weapon.
tip.umbra.keeper_horn: Remembers one lighthouse. Calls when they come for it.
tip.umbra.primordial_heart: Beating. The lighthouse's light or the dark around you: yours to choose.
tip.umbra.dispeller: A flash that scatters shadows. The big ones it only stings.
tip.umbra.mirror: Shows what does not like its own reflection.
tip.umbra.ward: Feeds on luminite. Fed, it keeps nightmares outside.
tip.umbra.luminite_lantern: An empty lantern asks for a crystal.
tip.umbra.luminite_lantern_block: Light eaters leave this light alone.
tip.umbra.luminite_shield: Takes a blow like any shield, and answers with light.
tip.umbra.quantum_compass: The needle seeks mazes that change while you aren't looking.
tip.umbra.underside_key: A frame of dusk stone. The key does the rest.
tip.umbra.lighthouse_lamp: Eats luminite. The brighter, the further the dark stays.
tip.umbra.architect_seal: Through some walls, it lets you see.
tip.umbra.trophy_watcher: Its place is on Yan's shelf.
tip.umbra.trophy_mimic_queen: Its place is on Yan's shelf.
tip.umbra.trophy_shepherd: Its place is on Yan's shelf.
tip.umbra.trophy_doppelganger: Its place is on Yan's shelf.
tip.umbra.trophy_architect: Its place is on Yan's shelf.
tip.umbra.trophy_primordial_shadow: Its place is on Yan's shelf.
tip.umbra.luminite_spear: Reaches further. The things of the Underside fear its sting.
tip.umbra.shepherd_scythe: The Shepherd gathered his flock with it. Now it reaps them.
tip.umbra.shadow_dagger: Quick. The one who does not see it coming takes it twice.
enchantment.umbra.radiance.desc: The blade burns the things of the Underside harder.
enchantment.umbra.clarity.desc: Every creature of the Underside you kill gives back a little of your mind.
enchantment.umbra.shadow_cut.desc: Sometimes your shadow strikes again from behind the target.
set.umbra.gloom: Full set: steadfast in the Underside, their blows weaker.
set.umbra.shadow: Full set: sight in the dark; crouch and the far ones lose you.
set.umbra.luminite: Full set: their blows weaker, light eaters burn near you.
set.umbra.gloom.on: The gloom steel closes round you. The Underside weighs less.
set.umbra.shadow.on: The shadow covers you whole. The dark turns clear.
set.umbra.luminite.on: The crystals ring in tune. The light stays close.
tip.umbra.luminite_bow: Its arrows burn the things of the Underside and give them away in light.
tip.umbra.shadow_knife: Throw it. Twice as bad in the back. Sometimes it comes back.
tip.umbra.echo_staff: A cry that goes through armour. It eats echo quartz.
message.umbra.echo_staff.empty: The staff has nothing to cry with: it needs echo quartz.
infusion.umbra.watcher: The Watcher's eye: a blow pins it down (Slowness II).
infusion.umbra.mimic_queen: The Queen's hunger: part of the damage comes back as health.
infusion.umbra.shepherd: The Shepherd's call: creatures around turn on the wounded one.
infusion.umbra.doppelganger: The reflection: now and then your double repeats the blow.
infusion.umbra.architect: The Architect's stone: now and then it roots them to the ground.
infusion.umbra.primordial_shadow: The eldest dark: in the dark it strikes them a third harder.
infusion.umbra.how: At the gloom anvil it can be infused into a melee weapon.
tip.umbra.marta_lantern: It never goes out. While it is in your hand, the head is clearer.
tip.umbra.yan_spyglass: What you see through it, you will see through a wall.
tip.umbra.keeper_bell: The dark does not like this ring.
errand.umbra.yan_notes.ask: Yan: “Marta wrote wherever she went. Find at least four of her notes, read them. I want to know where she was going.”
errand.umbra.yan_notes.wait: Yan: “The notes. Four. She hid them where it is darkest.”
errand.umbra.yan_notes.thanks: Yan: “To the seal, then... Here. This is her lantern, I made mine after it. The plan is yours.”
errand.umbra.yan_onslaught.ask: Yan: “They will come for the lamp. When they come, do not leave. Hold the lighthouse and I will give you my spyglass.”
errand.umbra.yan_onslaught.wait: Yan: “Not yet? They will. The horn will call you.”
errand.umbra.yan_onslaught.thanks: Yan: “We held. Here, how to make it is drawn here. Through it you can see who hides.”
errand.umbra.yan_citadel.ask: Yan: “The citadel. Marta went there and did not come back. Get at least to the gates, see what is there.”
errand.umbra.yan_citadel.wait: Yan: “The citadel is far. A key of four seals, remember?”
errand.umbra.yan_citadel.thanks: Yan: “You were there... Take the plan of the Keepers' bell. The dark cannot bear its ring. I do not need it any more.”
journal.umbra.yan_gift_lantern.title: Marta's Lantern
journal.umbra.yan_gift_lantern.text: Yan gave me the plan of a lantern that never goes out. He says Marta never put it out.
journal.umbra.yan_gift_spyglass.title: Yan's Spyglass
journal.umbra.yan_gift_spyglass.text: Copper and echo quartz. Look at a creature through it, and it glows after, even behind a wall.
journal.umbra.yan_gift_bell.title: The Keeper's Bell
journal.umbra.yan_gift_bell.text: The Keepers rang these when the dark came close. It backs away from the ring, but not for long.
